column1: # Limoniter in Spanish. Each line: the English, a tab, then the Spanish. \n is a new line, \t a tab and \\ a backslash.
# Placeholders in braces ({name}, {}, {:04X}) stay exactly as they are, in whatever order reads well; unnamed {} stay in their order.

! name: and //! about: describe it, //! command: Its title = function adds a command, and //! on_open:, //! on_save:, //! on_send: or //! on_run: function names what runs when. In on_send, send_device() names the device and set_send_name("NAME") changes the name it's sent as.

En on_send, send_device() indica el dispositivo y set_send_name("NAME") cambia el nombre con el que se envía.
